edits.old: Formal construction can also change what a system admits. Spencer-Brown's calculus of distinction makes re-entry—the return of a distinction into its own space—a specific problem. In a two-state reading, crossing changes either state into the other. A value required to equal its own crossing has no stable solution among those two states; repeated crossing alternates them. Varela's extension introduces an autonomous third state with rules governing its reduction alongside the others.[^s01-11] The new possibility depends on those rules. It makes a particular self-reference tractable by altering the available formal construction.

edits.old:
Kashmir gives this second question a developed philosophical body. Abhinavagupta's Śaiva account joins *prakāśa*, the luminosity of appearing, with *vimarśa*, awareness's intrinsic apprehension of itself. The two are inseparable because a merely inert illumination would not explain the knowing of what appears. Nor would an undifferentiated knowing explain the distinctions actually present in experience. A colour, its difference from another colour, and the recognition of that difference must be possible within the one field of awareness.[^s1-9]

The distinction of knower, means of knowing and known makes this unity articulate. The known can change while the act remains an act of knowing; the means can differ while the encountered difference is still given within awareness. Placing the knower outside the relation as a fourth object would leave the knowing of that object to be explained again. The source is instead present through the powers by which a determinate encounter takes place. Those powers differentiate the field without requiring a second independent substance beyond it.
edits.new: The Kashmiri account developed through Abhinavagupta gives the second question a philosophical body we can now recognise. Prakāśa and vimarśa have already shown how a colour and its contrast can be manifest and apprehended within one awareness. The changing content does not have to become a second substance outside that awareness in order to be different.[^s1-9] Here this anatomy meets the mathematical text's question of invariance: the source can remain itself through a real differentiation whose particular forms do change.

edits.old:

These cannot be placed beside each other as two specimens of unity. Counting the first as an additional object would produce another determination within the field whose unity was in question. The second, however definite, depends upon what its contour does not contain. A red mark stands out through a surrounding surface, a capacity to see colour and the continuity which lets this appearance belong to one experience. Its boundary is real. The boundary does not originate all the conditions through which it becomes visible.

The notation `0/1` assigns these different offices: `0 = One = Self-Identity`; `1 = All = Self-Difference`. Zero bears One because the condition is not another conditioned item. The positive mark bears All because determination opens a field: with this mark come other possible marks, contrasts between them, ways of recognising an occurrence again and circumstances in which it will do another job. All names the manifest and determinable whole, including the indefinite particular through which it appears. It cannot be completed by adding a last object to an inventory.[^native]

edits.old: Another net conducts attention through another source-world. In the Huayan contemplation traditionally attributed to Dushun, clear jewels reflect one another throughout Indra's net, and the reflections recur within their reflections. The teaching asks us to select one jewel on the southwest side. The entire reflected field becomes available through that particular entrance.[^indra] How can one enter all the jewels while remaining in this one? Remaining is the condition of entry. The selected jewel is already constituted through the others; it need not abandon its particularity to acquire relation. A second question resists making this one sufficient by itself: if everything is disclosed in one jewel, why is there a net of many? Because the one in its comprehensive aspect depends upon those many. Removing them would remove what makes it this jewel in this net. Another jewel can also be chosen. The first entrance acquires no permanent privilege through having been first. The contemplation then proposes a dot of ink. Mark the southwest jewel and the mark appears throughout the reflected field. Nobody travels from jewel to jewel painting each in turn. One alteration becomes visible through many places because their appearances are already related. The particular act retains its particularity while its consequences disclose a reach beyond its place. At this point the source qualifies the image which has made its teaching visible. Reflections enter one another, but the substances of the jewels remain separate; the interpenetration of phenomena being taught exceeds the optical likeness. The simile's limit is part of the contemplation, not an objection added from outside it. Its closing movement turns towards Vairocana's activity for beings, formlessness appearing through forms. The image has opened understanding and relinquished the claim to contain what it opens. The two nets now make different demands. Hephaestus's device holds bodies whose release requires a changed undertaking. The Huayan contemplation discloses a local appearance through its constituting relations and then acknowledges its own representational limit. Reflection does not assume a debt; mutual visibility does not create trust. Equally, Hephaestus's release prevents craft from being equated with captivity. Each whole resists an easy reading of the other.
edits.new: The Huayan jewel-net now returns with a question raised by this release. The southwest jewel disclosed the many through one particular entrance; the ink mark became visible elsewhere through their existing relations. Its two questions prevented that entrance from becoming self-sufficient, and the teaching's own optical qualification returned the image towards Vairocana's activity for beings.[^indra] Hephaestus's net holds bodies whose release requires a changed undertaking. The jewel-net makes a local appearance intelligible through its constituting relations. Neither operation can do the other's work: a reflected mark assumes no debt, while Poseidon's undertaking changes who will answer for a possible loss. The first telling made dependence perceptible; the present encounter requires someone to act within it. Their conjunction makes the difference between mutual visibility and entrusted continuation newly exact.

edits.reason: M23 already taught phase-space, attractor, basin and bifurcation; M28 supplied chart transitions. Gather these achievements through the jigsaw’s changed office rather than reset the definitions.
edits.old: The distinction between atlas and dynamics now becomes decisive. A phase-space represents possible states; a trajectory is one history through it. An attractor is an invariant organisation toward which an appropriate set of trajectories tends, and its basin identifies the starting conditions with that tendency. A bifurcation changes the regime of possible motion. Charts describe such objects locally and translate their descriptions; changing a chart does not by itself change the system. If a symbol changes the interpreter's expectations, attachments or available responses, however, the later trajectory can change. The difference between a better description and a transformed life must remain visible.
edits.new: The jigsaw's altered joins give the earlier distinction between a description and a transformation a precise test. Translating a trajectory into another chart preserves the motion being described. Changing the conditions which govern that motion can change the trajectory, its attractor or the basins from which an organisation is approached. Chart compatibility supplies none of those changes on its own. In a symbolic encounter, the corresponding question is whether the person has acquired another description of the same expectation or a changed capacity to receive and act. The atlas makes the descriptions comparable; the encounter must establish what has changed in the life.

edits.reason: M30 has earned affirmative psychoid priority. Receive it at its full strength and open the new burden of experienced significance rather than re-prove it.
edits.old: The psychoid names the ordering relation before its division into an exclusively psychic interior and an exclusively physical exterior. Those two regions are already determinations within a world that can be experienced and investigated. Their distinction is indispensable, but it cannot supply its own relation merely by assigning everything to one side or the other. Number makes the difficulty particularly clear. A numerical relation can be grasped inwardly, without the presence of the objects it subsequently orders; an encounter with those objects can also force the revision of what someone thought the relation meant. Neither direction makes the other dispensable. The common ordering field is active in both. To call it psychoid is to affirm that priority while preserving the different means through which its determinations become knowable.[^s4-01]
edits.new: The psychoid relation established through the Arche-Topos now has to be encountered from within a life. Number can be grasped inwardly without the objects it subsequently orders; those objects can also resist an interpretation of what the relation means. Exactness constrains the thinking that apprehends it, while apprehension gives the exact relation a place in an inquiry. Psychic and physical determinations retain their different warrants within the common ordering field. What follows concerns how that field becomes significant to the person participating in it.[^s4-01]

edits.reason: Carry forward the actual unsent accusation and criterion inquiry of M23. The new movement begins with their insufficiency to redistribute psychic investment, not with another introduction of the delayed message.
edits.old:
A person waiting for a reply can inhabit a world already organised by its absence. The delay seems to disclose an intention: I am being ignored. Attention searches the preceding exchange for the moment at which affection cooled. An ambiguous sentence acquires a hard edge. Memories of other silences become available, while occasions on which a delay meant nothing are harder to recall. Before any answer arrives, the person has begun to answer the silence.

The delay arrives within a history of interpretation. A defensive message may provoke the withdrawal it anticipated. Refusing to send anything may become another way of testing the other: surely someone who cared would know to ask. Each response can return material that the original interpretation knows how to receive. The account becomes more coherent as the encounter becomes less open. The other may actually be withdrawing. What matters is whether that possibility remains one question in the relationship or has become the condition under which every answer must be understood.[^s4-07]
edits.new:
The accusation has remained unsent, but the waiting person still reaches for the screen. Knowing how the rejection story formed has not removed the pull of it. An ambiguous sentence from the earlier exchange acquires its hard edge again; memories of other silences are readily available. A defensive message could provoke the withdrawal it anticipates. Silence could become another test which the other is expected to understand without being told.

The account examined in §2 can therefore survive its own explanation. Its criterion is now visible, yet it still offers a familiar way to bear the delay and a course to take. The other may actually be withdrawing. The further question concerns the investment through which this one possibility commands attention before an answer arrives, and the change that would let a real answer determine what follows.[^s4-07]

edits.new: The rejection story still offers protection even when its reasoning is exposed. It ends the open waiting, gives the hurt a cause and preserves a practised identity: the one who sees disappointment coming, the one who will not be made a fool of again. The person may understand this service and continue to need it. Relinquishing the story now means meeting the desire and uncertainty it had organised, without yet knowing whether another response will be bearable.

A person recognises themselves through it, and the history gathered under the name begins to appear as the source of every new act. The question now reaches the means of that identification—how can their operation become available to the one identifying?

edits.reason: M05 established perspective and integral co-presence; M35 inherits that history and advances into invested conduct and the full resistant Daphne encounter.
edits.old:
The return through a sign becomes integral when the conditions of a whole way of seeing enter what can be seen. Gebser's account of perspective gives this demand a historical body. Represented depth and landscape make an ego–world relation visible; Alberti's visual construction and Leonardo's optical articulation give it an exact means. Art, scientific description and technical making develop together because a position can now be related systematically to what appears from it. Perspective is a genuine acquisition of power.[^s4-32]

The acquisition establishes a limit as well. A sector orders what it can show by the position from which it is drawn. When that sector becomes the exclusive model of intelligibility, what falls outside the view is treated as though it fell outside what can matter. Gebser's aperspectival direction releases this exclusivity while retaining the powers of perspective. His attention to time and multiple aspects in later painting is significant for the same reason. The work changes what representation permits; it does not simply accumulate more objects inside an unchanged picture.

Integral diaphaneity develops the earlier structures through their co-presence and transparency. This is a further achievement because the seeing becomes aware of structures through which it proceeds, including those it had dismissed as superseded. Earlier modes of experience need not obtain permission from a single reigning mode before their psychic reality can be received. Rational discrimination remains active, but it no longer has to secure itself by denying the whole experience whose articulations it distinguishes. An extraordinary report and an ordinary perception can both be encountered, with their different histories, interpretations and warrants available for examination. Co-presence makes the differences consequential.
edits.new:
The view itself can now undergo the return which the sign has made possible. Gebser's account of perspective, encountered at the threshold, gave represented depth and the positioned viewer their historical relation. His later attention to time and multiple aspects in painting extends the question: a work can change the conditions of showing, rather than add more objects to the same view.[^s4-32]

Integral diaphaneity makes earlier structures available through their co-presence. Rational discrimination retains its acquired power while the modes it had treated as superseded can participate in what is received. The psychic reality of an unfamiliar experience and the warrant of its interpretation remain different questions. The change in the person is now decisive: can an experience alter the view's governing terms, or will the admission that those terms are partial become one more way of preserving them?

edits.reason: M05 and M30 already give the full optical scene and source assignments. M36 develops intervention and repeatable refraction instead of narrating the window from scratch a third time.
edits.old:
Light enters a room through a window of coloured glass. The image on the floor is definite: this colour falls here, another there. Its differences carry a construction which the image alone cannot show completely. Glass, thickness, angle, placement and the lead between panes have changed the light's passage. The room and viewer supply further conditions. What appears first as a finished picture can be followed back through the relations that made it appear.

The whole image gives the Meta-Epistemic Framework its operative form. Bimba names the originating order; QL is its implicated harmonic articulation, figured by the spectrum within the light. MEF comprises the refracting means—the panes, materials, angles, densities and joins. The situated projection is *pratibimba*. The pane does not originate the capacity for colour, and the completed picture does not become the source of what it displays. The observer nevertheless encounters the projection before recognising its conditions. What is prior in being can be later in knowledge.[^s4-38]

The joins are part of the work. A seam can preserve a historical discontinuity, a translation limit, the change from an author's claim to an interpreter's extension, or the difference between mathematical demonstration and psychic encounter. Removing every seam would conceal the transitions through which the materials compose their disclosure. Nor does an inventory of panes give the light's movement. Their relation has to be enacted in what the whole makes visible.

As light, viewer and angle change, another projection becomes available. A region previously obscured appears; a difference attributed to the object can be traced to a pane. Recognition returns to the aperture: a relation is reconsidered, a source reread, a translation corrected or an exclusion allowed to affect the next judgment. The scene is complete with this return. It figures a construction capable of learning from its disclosure, rather than a finished picture accompanied by a list of its materials.
edits.new:
The coloured window can now be approached from the side of its alteration. Its first appearance at the threshold let a projected image disclose the aperture which formed it; the mathematical return distinguished the Original, the spectral order, the refracting conditions and the situated projection. Bimba, QL, MEF and pratibimba name those different offices. What is prior in being can be later in knowledge: the viewer encounters the image before recognising how it came to appear.[^s4-38]

A pane can now be repositioned. A different angle, material or join changes what passes into the room; moving the viewer changes what can be received. Following a difference back to the appropriate condition makes this a test of transformation, not only transparency. A historical discontinuity must remain a discontinuity; a translation needs its particular limits; a mathematical demonstration and a psychic encounter bring different warrants. The joins retain these relations so that a corrected reading can reach the source, aperture or act which actually requires change.

edits.old:
**Objective Internality names the constituted means through which a Life encounters and acts within a World.** A remembered promise, an acquired language and a distinction one has learned to notice belong to those means. So can a notebook, a program, a technical instrument or another person's contribution, insofar as it enters the living relation of knowing and doing. The internality is objective because its determinations can be encountered, investigated and changed. It is internal because those determinations participate in the activity whose world they disclose. The older image of a maker, a trap and a pledge gives another way to understand this relation. In the song of Ares and Aphrodite, Helios sees the lovers and tells Hephaestus. The maker turns knowledge into a device: bonds so fine that the lovers do not see them. He arranges the trap around the bed and makes a show of leaving for Lemnos. Hephaestus summons the gods to witness what has happened. His craft has made private conduct publicly demonstrable. Yet the spectators do not form a single moral tribunal. The gods laugh; Hermes is willing to imagine accepting even greater bonds for the pleasure of lying beside Aphrodite. The goddesses stay away. The public display therefore establishes the event without establishing a common judgment of its meaning. Hephaestus's demand concerning the marriage gifts belongs to one relation of redress; the adulterer's fine belongs to another. Proof has not dissolved the interests of those who receive it.

Poseidon does not join the laughter. He asks for Ares to be released and initially offers the prospect that Ares will pay. Hephaestus answers the actual weakness of that proposal: how could such a pledge be enforced if Ares escaped? Poseidon then undertakes to pay himself should Ares default. The release follows this assumption of contingent liability. The maker loosens the bonds. Ares goes to Thrace, Aphrodite to Paphos. The song does not narrate the payment, a repaired marriage or a newly harmonious household. It gives a release whose risk has acquired an answerable bearer.

Gustave Le Bon approaches collective participation through its power to change how people perceive and act. Carl Gustav Jung brings the question to the responsibility surrendered when the State is treated as a person.
